//firestore: DELIBERATELY ABSENT, and this note is here so nobody helpfully adds it back. This app is a READ CONSUMER of the 'teacher-corner-dev' database, which is owned by the Angular Teacher Corner web app in ~/code/teacher-corner. That app's firestore.rules is the ONLY ruleset governing this data and is deployed only from there. A 'firestore' block here would give this repo a path to overwrite it: rules deploys REPLACE a database's whole ruleset rather than merging, so one careless 'firebase deploy' from this directory could revoke the live web app's own access. With no block at all, 'firebase deploy --only firestore' from here has nothing to target and fails instead of succeeding destructively.

functions.//: ONLY this directory. Forked from the web app (~/code/teacher-corner/functions-otp), retargeted to the divya-teacher-corner database with tcDivya* names.
functions.//codebase: LOAD-BEARING. helix-staging-india also runs the web app's tcDevSendOtp/tcDevVerifyOtp (codebase 'tcdev-otp') and sendWelcomeEmail/expenseLogTotals (unlabelled, so DEFAULT codebase). The CLI only considers same-codebase functions for deletion, so a codebase of our own puts all of those structurally out of reach of a deploy from here. Never change this to 'default'.
